verdict.rationale: HubSpot's reporting product lets you build custom dashboards that combine multiple reports (hubspot-docs-42, hubspot-docs-34). Reports cover marketing, sales, revenue, and service analytics with filters and chart types (hubspot-docs-49, hubspot-docs-67), and Breeze Assistant can build a report from a plain-language description (hubspot-docs-50). Dozens of customizable pre-built sales reports include monitoring of team sales activities (hubspot-docs-43, hubspot-docs-36, hubspot-docs-59), so all of this happens in-product without exporting to a spreadsheet. Missing for 10: pipeline and conversion reports are not explicitly named in the evidence, the claims come from marketing pages rather than in-depth how-to docs, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
